snippet.title: This Simple Calculation Made Her Quit Her Job!
snippet.description:
Fill this form to be featured on Wint Wealth: 
https://forms.gle/iuUgM7fyGTfUUiVE9

Meet Susila Cherla, she was earning ₹50 LPA at Nokia. She had a stable career, a growing salary, and every reason to stay. But at 38, she did the math 12,000 days left to live and decided that was not how she wanted to spend them.

In this video, we sit down with a former Nokia senior executive who quit her high-paying corporate job, built a ₹4 Crore+ corpus, and achieved financial independence before 50 without waiting for a ₹1 Crore salary.

She breaks down:
→ How she calculated her "enough" number and why ₹1 Crore was sufficient for her
→ How she split financial responsibilities with her spouse and why she insists on financial independence even within marriage
→ Her 40-40-20 portfolio split (mutual funds, real estate, fixed deposits)
→ How she started investing with a ₹200 RD on a ₹1,000 stipend and what that compounded to
→ Why she believes "should" is the biggest destroyer of peace of mind
→ The pragmatic vs emotional framework she uses for every major life decision

This is not a story about getting rich. It's a story about deciding what's enough and having the financial discipline to get there.

If you're thinking about early retirement in India, wondering how much corpus you actually need, or trying to build financial independence on a regular salary this conversation is for you.

snippet.title: Top Transport Inventions 🚗 #History #Education #Inventions #Innovation
snippet.description:
Train (1804) – The first steam locomotive was built by Richard Trevithick in the United Kingdom. It demonstrated that steam power could move heavy loads on rails, laying the foundation for modern railway transport.

Tram (1832) – The first urban streetcar system began operating in New York. These early trams were pulled by horses and helped create efficient public transport in rapidly growing cities.

Bicycle (1861) – The first practical pedal bicycle was developed in France by Pierre Michaux and Pierre Lallement. It introduced pedals attached to the front wheel, making cycling a popular and efficient personal transport method.

Automobile (1885) – Karl Benz in Germany created the first gasoline-powered automobile, the Benz Patent-Motorwagen. This invention marked the beginning of modern cars and transformed personal transportation worldwide.
